name: @neuropause/enterprise-connectivity
description: NeuroPause Enterprise Management System — Launch Workstream 3: Enterprise Integrations & AI Connectivity. An additive package that composes Waves 1-14, Sprints 1-6, and Launch Workstreams 1-2, unchanged, into a governed enterprise-connectivity layer: an enterprise connector runtime (registry/lifecycle/status/health/config/discovery/permissions, reusing the Sprint-3 integration platform — a connector is 'active' only after configuration AND verification); identity federation for Microsoft Entra ID/Google Workspace/Okta/Auth0 (SSO/OAuth2/OIDC/SCIM/org-mapping, represented until configured); productivity/ERP/CRM/storage/communication connector catalogs (Microsoft 365/Google Workspace/Slack/Teams/Zoom/Notion, SAP/Oracle/Dynamics/Odoo, Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho/Dynamics CRM, Google Drive/OneDrive/SharePoint/Dropbox/Box/S3, Gmail/Outlook/Exchange/Twilio — reusing the integration-platform adapter frameworks; no synchronized data is ever fabricated); an AI provider platform (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Azure OpenAI/Ollama/Mistral with real in-process routing/failover/model-selection + usage/rate-limit registries, reusing the AI runtime — external AI usage is never fabricated); an enterprise data-synchronization engine (scheduler/incremental/full/conflict-detection/retry-queue/history, reusing the integration-platform real diff engine — sync runs only for configured+verified connectors); data mapping (schema registry/field mapping/transformation rules/validation/version, reusing the integration-platform transformation engine); AI workspace context assembled ONLY from configured connectors; enterprise search over represented metadata; integration monitoring (reusing Launch-Workstream-1 platform operations + integration-platform monitoring); and security & governance. The connector runtime/registry, data mapping, sync engine, AI routing, AI provider registry, identity federation, workspace context, search engine, monitoring, and governance are LIVE-VERIFIED in-process; Microsoft 365/Google Workspace/Slack/Teams/Salesforce/SAP/OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini/Azure OpenAI/Google Drive/OneDrive (and more) are ADAPTER-VERIFIED until configured; customer records/ERP/CRM/email/calendar data, file metadata, and AI usage are BUSINESS-DATA-PENDING; and enterprise OAuth credentials, customer APIs, production webhooks, and enterprise tenant connections are INFRASTRUCTURE-PENDING. No successful synchronization with customer systems, live OAuth authorization, production API traffic, customer enterprise data, or external AI usage is ever claimed; every operation is audited on the one chain with a replay id.
